#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Transitive import closure of a project module, computed purely from `import`
lines (code regions only; block/line comments stripped). Only project-local
modules (NavierStokes.*, Euler.*, ComparatorChallenges.*, and the root modules
NavierStokes / Euler) are followed; external modules (Mathlib, Comparator, ...)
are recorded as leaves and not followed.
usage: closure.py <project_root> <Module.Name> [sorry-module ...]"""
import os, re, sys, json
ROOT = sys.argv[1]; START = sys.argv[2]; SORRY_MODS = set(sys.argv[3:])
LOCAL_PREFIX = ("NavierStokes", "Euler", "ComparatorChallenges")
def path_of(mod):
    p = os.path.join(ROOT, *mod.split(".")) + ".lean"
    return p if os.path.exists(p) else None
def strip_comments(src):
    out=[]; i=0; n=len(src); depth=0
    while i<n:
        if depth==0:
            if src.startswith("/-",i): depth=1; i+=2; continue
            if src.startswith("--",i):
                j=src.find("\n",i); i = n if j<0 else j; continue
            out.append(src[i]); i+=1
        else:
            if src.startswith("/-",i): depth+=1; i+=2; continue
            if src.startswith("-/",i): depth-=1; i+=2; continue
            if src[i]=="\n": out.append("\n")
            i+=1
    return "".join(out)
IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*import\s+(.+?)\s*$", re.M)
def imports_of(mod):
    p = path_of(mod)
    src = strip_comments(open(p, encoding="utf-8").read())
    mods=[]
    for m in IMPORT_RE.finditer(src):
        mods.extend(m.group(1).split())
    return mods
seen={}; external=set(); stack=[START]; missing=set()
while stack:
    m=stack.pop()
    if m in seen: continue
    if not m.split(".")[0] in LOCAL_PREFIX:
        external.add(m); continue
    if path_of(m) is None:
        missing.add(m); continue
    imps=imports_of(m); seen[m]=imps
    stack.extend(imps)
local=sorted(seen)
sorry_in=sorted(set(local)&SORRY_MODS)
chal_in=sorted(x for x in local if x.startswith("ComparatorChallenges"))
print(json.dumps({"start":START,"local_closure_size":len(local),
  "external_leaves":sorted(external),"missing_local_modules":sorted(missing),
  "sorry_modules_in_closure":sorry_in,"challenge_modules_in_closure":chal_in,
  "by_prefix":{p:sum(1 for x in local if x==p or x.startswith(p+".")) for p in LOCAL_PREFIX}},indent=1))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract `theorem <name> ... :=` statement text from two files and diff them
(raw and whitespace-normalised). usage: stmtdiff.py root fileA fileB name..."""
import sys, re, difflib, os, json
ROOT, A, B = sys.argv[1:4]; names = sys.argv[4:]
def stmt(path, name):
    src = open(os.path.join(ROOT, path), encoding="utf-8").read()
    m = re.search(r"^theorem\s+" + re.escape(name) + r"\b(.*?):=", src, re.S | re.M)
    return m.group(0) if m else None
out = {}
for n in names:
    a, b = stmt(A, n), stmt(B, n)
    norm = lambda s: re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip() if s else s
    d = list(difflib.unified_diff((a or "").splitlines(), (b or "").splitlines(), A, B, lineterm=""))
    out[n] = {"raw_identical": a == b, "ws_normalised_identical": norm(a) == norm(b),
              "found_in_A": a is not None, "found_in_B": b is not None, "raw_diff": "\n".join(d)}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
